capabilities: : Ask AI questions about selection or note
: Stream AI-generated text into the note
: Configure various AI agents and APIs
extras: Credentials (API keys, bridge keys) are stored in plain text in the vault's .obsidian/plugins/notekit-edit/data.json.
intentEvidence: Notekit Edit is an Obsidian plugin that turns any passage of a note into a prompt: select text, say what should change, and the rewrite streams into the note in place.
problem: Manually rewriting or generating content within a note is time-consuming and disruptive to the writing flow.
summary: AI-powered editor that allows users to select text or place a cursor and use AI models like Claude or ChatGPT to rewrite or generate content directly into the note.
